AzureResourceProperties.description: Common properties for all azure tracked and proxy resources.

provisioningState.description: The status of the last operation.

CreateWavesFromPlanRequest.description: Request body for the createWavesFromPlan action.

assessmentArmId.description: ARM Id of the source assessment. Used together with migrationPath so the server can resolve the latest Active wave plan for the (assessmentArmId, migrationPath) tuple at LRO start.

migrationPath.description: Migration path of the wave plan to create waves from. Allowed values include PaaSPreferred, PaaSCentric, IaaSCentric, RecommendedPath, AzureVM, Avs, SqlDatabase, SqlMI, AzureSQLVM, AzureAppService, AzureAppServiceContainer, AKS, Modernize, LiftAndShift.

waveSelection.description: Optional subset of waves from the resolved plan to create, identified by waveName plus the desired waveDisplayName for each. When omitted, all waves in the resolved plan are created.

CreateWavesFromPlanResponse.description: Response body for the createWavesFromPlan action. Top-level counters describe the outcome; when at least one wave failed, sasUri and expirationTime carry a pointer to a per-invocation outcome-report CSV. On all-success or all-skipped runs both fields are omitted.

totalWaves.description: Total number of waves the operation attempted to create.

succeededWaves.description: Number of waves that were created successfully.

failedWaves.description: Number of waves that failed to create.

skippedWaves.description: Number of waves that were skipped (for example, a wave with the same name already existed and the conflict policy was skip).

sasUri.description: Time-bound, read-only SAS URL to a per-invocation outcome-report CSV enumerating each failed wave with a failureReason and remediation column. Present only when failedWaves is greater than zero.

expirationTime.description: UTC instant after which sasUri ceases to be valid. Present only when sasUri is present.

ExecutionMode.description: Execution mode for the migration process.

values.name: TaskBased
values.description: Task-based execution mode, where tasks are executed in a predefined sequence.

values.name: RunbookBased
values.description: Runbook-based execution mode, where runbooks perform the migration process.

FetchSasUriResponse.description: Response body for the fetchSASUri action.

sasUri.description: Write-targeted short-lived SAS URL pointing into the server-managed CSV staging container. Callers PUT their wave-plan CSV payload to this URL and then pass the same URL verbatim as the sasUri field on importWavePlan.

expirationTime.description: UTC instant after which sasUri ceases to be valid.

GenerateWavePlanRequest.description: Request body for the generateWavePlan action.

assessmentArmId.description: ARM Id of the assessment for which the wave plan report is to be generated. Required from API version 2026-06-01-preview onwards.

migrationPath.description: Migration path for which the wave plan report is to be generated. Required from API version 2026-06-01-preview onwards. Allowed values include PaaSPreferred, PaaSCentric, IaaSCentric, RecommendedPath, AzureVM, Avs, SqlDatabase, SqlMI, AzureSQLVM, AzureAppService, AzureAppServiceContainer, AKS, Modernize, LiftAndShift.

GenerateWavePlanResponse.description: Response body for the generateWavePlan action.

sasUri.description: Time-bound SAS URL to the wave-plan artifact. Expires at expirationTime; never persisted on the wave-plan document.

expirationTime.description: UTC instant after which sasUri ceases to be valid.

wavePlanName.description: Server-allocated friendly identifier for the wave plan. Output-only.

provisioningState.description: The status of the last operation on the wave plan.

planSource.description: How the wave plan was produced. Always SystemGenerated for plans produced by generateWavePlan.

assessmentArmId.description: ARM Id of the source assessment the wave plan was generated from. Echoed from the request.

migrationPath.description: Migration path the wave plan was generated for. Echoed from the request. Allowed values include PaaSPreferred, PaaSCentric, IaaSCentric, RecommendedPath, AzureVM, Avs, SqlDatabase, SqlMI, AzureSQLVM, AzureAppService, AzureAppServiceContainer, AKS, Modernize, LiftAndShift.

GetWavePlansRequest.description: Request body for the getWavePlans action.

assessmentArmId.description: ARM Id of the source assessment. Required.

migrationPath.description: Optional migration path. When provided, restricts results to the supplied (assessmentArmId, migrationPath) combination; when omitted, returns wave plans across every migration path that has plans for the assessment. Allowed values include PaaSPreferred, PaaSCentric, IaaSCentric, RecommendedPath, AzureVM, Avs, SqlDatabase, SqlMI, AzureSQLVM, AzureAppService, AzureAppServiceContainer, AKS, Modernize, LiftAndShift.

GetWavePlansResponse.description: Response body for the getWavePlans action.

value.description: List of wave plan summary items. Returned in a single page; ordered by wavePlanVersion descending within each migration path.

ImportWavePlanRequest.description: Request body for the importWavePlan action.

assessmentArmId.description: ARM Id of the source assessment. Must belong to the same subscription, resource group, and migrate project as the request URL.

migrationPath.description: Migration path that the supplied wave plan applies to. Allowed values include PaaSPreferred, PaaSCentric, IaaSCentric, RecommendedPath, AzureVM, Avs, SqlDatabase, SqlMI, AzureSQLVM, AzureAppService, AzureAppServiceContainer, AKS, Modernize, LiftAndShift.

sasUri.description: SAS-signed URL to the customer-uploaded CSV. The recommended way to obtain this URL is to call fetchSASUri, PUT the CSV payload to the URL it returns, then pass that same URL verbatim here. The URL is fetched once during import and is neither persisted on the resulting wave plan nor echoed back on read.

ImportWavePlanResponse.description: Response body for the importWavePlan action.

wavePlanName.description: Server-allocated friendly identifier for the imported wave plan. Output-only.

provisioningState.description: The status of the last operation on the wave plan.

planSource.description: How the wave plan was produced. Always Imported for plans produced by importWavePlan.

assessmentArmId.description: ARM Id of the source assessment the wave plan was imported for. Echoed from the request.

migrationPath.description: Migration path the wave plan was imported for. Echoed from the request. Allowed values include PaaSPreferred, PaaSCentric, IaaSCentric, RecommendedPath, AzureVM, Avs, SqlDatabase, SqlMI, AzureSQLVM, AzureAppService, AzureAppServiceContainer, AKS, Modernize, LiftAndShift.

sasUri.description: Time-bound SAS URL to the parsed wave-plan JSON. Expires at expirationTime; never persisted on the wave-plan document.

expirationTime.description: UTC instant after which sasUri ceases to be valid.

values.name: Rehost
values.description: Rehost: Also known as 'lift and shift', this strategy involves moving existing applications to Azure without modification.

values.name: Refactor
values.description: Refactor: Often referred to as 'lift, tinker, and shift', this involves making minor modifications to the application to take advantage of Azure's cloud capabilities.

values.name: Rearchitect
values.description: Rearchitect: This approach involves significant changes to the application's architecture to fully utilize cloud-native features and scalability of Azure.

values.name: Rebuild
values.description: Rebuild: Involves completely redesigning and rewriting the application from scratch to be cloud-native, leveraging Azure's advanced services.

values.name: Replace
values.description: Replace: This strategy involves discarding the existing application and replacing it with a new Azure solution or a SaaS platform.

values.name: Retire
values.description: Retire: This strategy involves discarding the existing application and replacing it with a new Azure solution or a SaaS platform.

values.name: Retain
values.description: Retain: Keeping certain applications in the current environment when they are not suitable for cloud migration or when the timing is not right.

values.name: Replatform
values.description: Replatform: This strategy involves making more substantial changes to the application.
